extracted.name: Daddy K’s Corn Boiled in Milk
extracted.description: Ears of corn boiled in milk with cream, sugar, and butter for the tastiest, quickest, most sweet and tender corn on the cob ever!
ingredient_lines: water, or as needed to cover
0.33333334326744 cup white sugar, or more to taste
8 ears corn on the cob, husks and silk removed
instruction_lines: Bring water to a boil in a large stockpot; stir in milk, sugar, cream, and butter until sugar dissolves and butter melts.
Gently place ears of corn into the mixture and reduce heat to low. Simmer corn until tender, 7 to 8 minutes.
Remove corn from the pot with tongs and set aside under aluminum foil until serving time.
